*   **Ligand-field splitting parameter ($Dq$):** $979\text{ cm}^{-1}$
*   **Racah parameter ($B$):** $853\text{ cm}^{-1}$

*   $\nu_2 (18\,410\text{ cm}^{-1})$ matches the predicted $^4T_{1g} \to ^4A_{2g}$ transition.
*   $\nu_3 (20\,250\text{ cm}^{-1})$ matches the predicted $^4T_{1g} \to ^4T_{1g}(P)$ transition.
